title: Jaane-Anjaane
writer: Ranjan Bose, Vrajendra Gaur, Madhusudan Kalelkar
actors: Shammi Kapoor, Leena Chandavarkar, Sandhya Roy
plot: Laxmi Prasad finds an abandoned baby and decided to keep him. She and her husband Shankar named him Ramu. Shankar wants him to gamble and indulged in bootlegging. He grows up to become a criminal.
